scope_gap.statement: In Carrier's archived Fig 4.1 left-panel simulations (q=241,m=40,n=43,N=25971), the empirical Pwrong CDF is only recorded for T≤1803 (last positive mass at T=1802, log2(Pwrong)≈-35.70), while every one of 4000 Pgood scores lies at T≥6668 (median 11964). The operating threshold with Pgood≈1/2 is therefore entirely outside the experimentally measured Pwrong T-range (fraction inside = 0). Kyber-scale Table C.2 CC log2(Pwrong) values (−119.57/−177.79/−244.03) lie another ~-84+ bits below that toy simulation floor.
